description.text:
The deck that won the Junior Division of the 2012 World Championships. Its only Pokémon are Mewtwo-EX and Terrakion, which leaves room for cards that fetch Energy for heavy hits, and Ruins of Alph takes away the opponent's Resistance. The 2012 World Championships were held at the Hilton Waikoloa Village in Waikoloa, Hawaii, from 10 to 12 August 2012.

Pokémon sold it as a 2012 World Championships deck: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a deck box and a pin. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
